issues.description: Exercise 5 (Kakuro): `GroverKakuro` constructor parameters are inconsistent. The template defines `GroverKakuro.__init__(self, size: int)`, but the solution defines `GroverKakuro.__init__(self)` with no `size` parameter. This breaks instantiation expectations (tests or student code) because the same class cannot be constructed the same way in both artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor signature consistent across template and solution. Prefer removing the unused `size: int` parameter from the template `__init__` (and adjust any text/tests accordingly), or alternatively add `size: int` to the solution `__init__` and use/store it.
